en.purpose: To derive the FIGO 2013 stage and substage for ovarian, fallopian tube, and primary peritoneal carcinoma based on recorded staging-relevant findings.
en.use:
Use to stage ovarian, fallopian tube, and primary peritoneal carcinoma by evaluating structured inputs describing tumour origin, anatomical extent of disease, lymph node involvement, peritoneal spread, and distant metastases.

The guideline processes the following inputs:
- Primary tumour origin (ovary, fallopian tube, or primary peritoneal carcinoma)
- Overall tumour extent (confined, pelvic extension, extrapelvic spread, or distant metastasis)
- Pattern of primary site involvement (laterality and confinement)
- Presence and type of tumour spill, surface involvement, or malignant cytology
- Pattern of pelvic extension
- Retroperitoneal lymph node involvement
- Size of the largest retroperitoneal nodal metastasis
- Extent of extrapelvic peritoneal disease
- Presence and type of distant metastasis

Based on the combination of these inputs, the guideline assigns the corresponding FIGO stage and substage (Stages I–IV, including substages IA–IC3, IIA–IIB, IIIA1i–IIIC, and IVA–IVB) according to the FIGO 2013 staging system.
en.misuse:
Not to be used for clinical or pathological TNM staging.
Not to be used for staging of other gynaecological malignancies.
